provenance.counting: UTC query rows excluding initialize/session_delete; failures included, no deduplication. Unknown protocol rows included in volume.
provenance.cohort_policy: Fixed historical five excluded across every client/version/day; missing hashes included. Only everyone_else is exported; excluded-cohort traffic is never charted.
provenance.coverage_limits: One preceding partition, plus one following partition only for completed end dates. Current UTC day is partial and has no following-day padding. Pinned source publication time is not complete event ingestion; late arrivals can revise counts. Static snapshot, not live.
provenance.motion_policy: 30s full series at 1x; requestAnimationFrame fractional day position; linear connection revelation only, not intraday estimates or rate smoothing; KPIs/date floor(position); no null/calendar gap bridging or future markers; continuously translating seven-day viewport; reduced motion explicit daily steps; latest paused, hidden page pauses
provenance.denominator: logged tool calls using 2026-07-28 / logged tool calls with a reviewed protocol version; five hashes excluded before aggregation; unknown/unreviewed protocols excluded; no minimum-volume suppression
provenance.rolling_policy: sum modern / sum valid over exactly seven completed UTC calendar days ending on selected day, or preceding partial day; unavailable without full calendar coverage or positive denominator
provenance.absence_policy: Absent client cells on covered, reconciled cube dates are no observed calls, not a zero share. Null means unavailable.
provenance.notice: Static snapshot, not live. Snapshot cutoff is source snapshot publication time, not a guarantee that all events were ingested. Logged tool calls, not protocol messages or users. Fixed five excluded across all clients/versions; missing hashes retained. Unknown/unreviewed protocols excluded from the denominator.
